title: Simple Listening Practice B1 Clean Script
audio_script: Welcome to the Simple Listening Practice. Please listen carefully to each statement and answer the question. Number 1. Woman: I'm sorry, I cannot find the file you asked for. Next question. Number 2. Man: Could you please show me the way to the meeting room? Next question. Number 3. Woman: Don't forget to back up the data before you leave today. Next question. Number 4. Man: Wow, your presentation this morning was excellent! Next question. Number 5. Woman: Would you like some help with those heavy backup drives? This is the end of the listening practice.

questions.text: What is the best response to the man's question?
options: Sure, just follow me down this hall.
questions.answer: Sure, just follow me down this hall.

questions.text: What is the woman telling the speaker to do?
What is the best response to the man's compliment?
options: Thank you, I worked hard on it.
questions.answer: Thank you, I worked hard on it.

questions.text: What is the best response to the woman's offer?
options: That would be great, thank you!
No, I don't have a drive.
